description: Codex smoke test: largest agents-info files
promptHead:
Read-only task. Do NOT create, edit or delete any file in the working directory.
In web/builtin/agents-info, list the 5 files with the most lines (name and line count, largest first), then say in one sentence which of them is closest to a 800-line limit.
Eval: the answer lists exactly 5 files with line counts that match `wc -l`.
End your reply with `Eval result: PASS` or `Eval result: FAIL`.
